'''Nogometni klub Vitez''' is a professional [[Association football|football]] club, based in the town of [[Vitez]], [[Bosnia and Herzegovina]]. The club currently plays in the [[First League of the Federation of Bosnia and Herzegovina]] and plays its home matches on the [[Vitez City Stadium|Gradski stadion]] in Vitez, which has a capacity of 3,500 seats.

The club's crest has a [[sword]] in front of a football ball. It also features the year when the club was established."}}
